# GA4 MCP Server

> Model Context Protocol server for Google Analytics 4. Read-only reporting, schema discovery, and 17 analytical skills that load on demand. MIT, local stdio, v2.11.7.

Docs: https://ga4mcp.com
Repo: https://github.com/surendranb/google-analytics-mcp
Not affiliated with Google.

## Install
- `curl -fsSL https://ga4.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- `uvx google-analytics-mcp`
- `npx -y @surendranb/google-analytics-mcp`

Requires `GA4_PROPERTY_ID` and `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`.

## Tools (12)
- `check_for_updates`: Check PyPI for newer versions of this MCP server and get upgrade instructions.
- `list_properties`: List all GA4 properties associated with an account.
- `search_schema`: Search for a keyword across all dimensions and metrics for this property.
- `get_property_schema`: Returns the complete schema for the configured GA4 property, including all available dimensions and metrics (standard and custom).
- `list_dimension_categories`: List all dimension categories for this GA4 property, with a count of dimensions in each category.
- `list_metric_categories`: List all metric categories for this GA4 property, with a count of metrics in each category.
- `get_dimensions_by_category`: Return all dimensions in a specific category with their API names and descriptions.
- `get_metrics_by_category`: Return all metrics in a specific category with their API names and descriptions.
- `get_ga4_data`: Retrieve GA4 data with built-in intelligence for better and safer results.
- `get_troubleshooting_guide`: Returns the troubleshooting/setup guide for a topic, served from inside the server (no network needed).
- `search_skills`: Fetch analytical recipes and how-to guides from the GA4 skills library.
- `setup_ga4_access`: Interactively fix a broken GA4 MCP setup (missing property ID, missing or expired credentials, or missing GA4 access) by asking the user for the needed input through...

## Skills (17)
- [Track AI Referral Traffic in Google Analytics 4](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/ai-referral-analysis/): How to track and measure traffic from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini in GA4. Exact dimension filters, regex patterns, and channel comparison rules.
- [GA4 Attribution Scope: User vs. Session vs. Event](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/attribution-scope/): Why session, user, and event metrics never match in GA4. Rules for pairing dimensions and metrics across user-scoped, session-scoped, and event-scoped models.
- [Identify & Filter Bot Traffic in Google Analytics 4](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/bot-traffic-detection/): Detect and filter automated bot spikes in Google Analytics 4. Patterns for datacenter ASN spikes, zero-second sessions, and single-page screenPageViews.
- [GA4 Channel Acquisition: Default Grouping Rules](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/channel-acquisition/): How GA4 Default Channel Groups work, how to audit channel performance, and how to spot traffic falling into Unassigned or Direct due to broken UTM parameters.
- [GA4 Dimensions and Metrics Reference: API Field Names](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/common-metric-names/): Exact API field names for GA4 Data API queries. Avoid 400 errors from Universal Analytics names like ga:sessions or pageviews by using valid GA4 schema.
- [Compatible Dimension & Metric Combinations in GA4](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/compatible-combinations/): Which dimensions and metrics can be queried together in GA4 without triggering incompatible scope errors. Matrix of user, session, and event-level pairings.
- [GA4 Content Performance: Views & Engagement Rates](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/content-performance/): Evaluate landing pages and blog content in GA4: screenPageViews, average engagement time, bounce rates, and organic search conversions per URL.
- [GA4 Custom Dimensions & Event Parameters Guide](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/custom-dimensions/): Query custom dimensions and event parameters in the GA4 Data API. How to find parameter names, register them in GA4 Admin, and query custom event schemas.
- [GA4 API Date Ranges: Syntax, Offsets & Comparisons](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/date-ranges/): Allowed date string formats for the GA4 Data API: YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday, 7daysAgo, 30daysAgo, and multi-range period comparisons without API errors.
- [GA4 Ecommerce Analysis: Revenue, AOV & Funnel Drop-off](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/ecommerce-analysis/): Analyze GA4 ecommerce performance: purchase revenue, average order value, checkout funnel drop-off, and item revenue by acquisition channel.
- [GA4 API Filter Expressions & Dimension Regex Syntax](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/filter-structures/): Copy-paste filter templates for the GA4 Data API: exact match, beginsWith, contains, regex, AND/OR group expressions, and inListFilter structures.
- [GA4 API Limitations, Quotas & Cardinality Boundaries](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/ga4-limitations/): GA4 Data API boundaries: 10-dimension limit, 100,000 row caps, hourly token quotas, and sampling thresholds. How to query safely within API limits.
- [GCP Service Account Setup for GA4 Data API](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/gcp-setup/): Step-by-step GCP service account provisioning for the GA4 Data API. Create JSON keys, assign the Viewer role in GA4 Admin, and avoid common 403 errors.
- [Geo and Device Segmentation](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/geo-device-segmentation/): Segment GA4 data by country, city, device category, and browser. Spot localization opportunities and mobile conversion drops with ready queries.
- [GA4 Service Account Setup Guide](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/service-account-setup/): Step-by-step GA4 service account setup. Generate Google Cloud JSON keys, enable the Data API, and grant Viewer permissions in Google Analytics Admin.
- [Diagnose GA4 Traffic Drops: Step-by-Step Triage](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/traffic-diagnosis/): A six-step triage framework to diagnose GA4 traffic drops. Isolate channel shifts, check tracking snippet errors, and distinguish real drops from bot drops.
- [Universal Analytics to GA4 Field Name Mapping](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/ua-to-ga4/): Mapping table from Universal Analytics (UA) field names to Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Data API names. Replace ga:pageviews, ga:bounces, and ga:users correctly.
